# Version 3.119.4
> **Cross-platform servicing release** · Released May 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.4)

> **Supersedes [3.119.3](3.119.3.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.5/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.4 improves platform reliability, native hardening, and supported view integrations. It rolls up the 3.119.3 preview work with Linux, Android, Tizen, and desktop fixes.

## Breaking Changes

- **Blazor view surface changed** — Review the API-diff report and update Blazor view code to use the current supported members before upgrading.

## Bug Fixes

- **Android GL views recover after tab switches** — MAUI applications no longer leave SKGLView blank after switching TabBar tabs. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Linux ARM64 runtime stability improved** — Native packaging and runtime dependencies are corrected for Linux ARM64 applications. ([#3494](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3494))

## Platform

- **Tizen and Linux support broadened** — The release adds 64-bit Tizen native support and Linux Bionic native assets. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.5

HarfBuzzSharp carries the accompanying platform and native dependency updates.
